what_differs: On 08-25 the client accepted the mockup ban-reason list for the player, and on 09-01 Jumpr decided to build the player ban from those mockup values. On 09-03 Jira (WAGR-154/156 comments) recorded that player ban reasons were cut, based on the earlier 08-18 call about restriction-detail fields. The WAGR-154 description and AC1 still require a reason. The only later 'no reason' confirmation is second-hand, in a Jira comment about the fraud banner.
suggested_action: Get one explicit written client answer: does the player Ban button capture a reason (picklist) or not? Then make the WAGR-154 description and acceptance criteria match the answer, and record the answer on WAGR-156.
